title: Choose the landing composition
question: All three use the chosen Field Note Constellation. Pick the composition that best expresses friends naturally getting each other next time.

options.label: Specimen to Story
options.thesis: One imported charge moves from a pinned bank record into a mapped friend group.
options.viewport: A single Luna Pizza charge anchors the page beside Jamie, Noor, and Eli, with the route continuing below the fold.
options.risk: It explains one expense clearly but says less about reciprocity across several purchases.

options.label: Three Paths Converge
options.thesis: Three friends take different purchase paths that visibly converge into one balanced group.
options.viewport: Jamie’s pizza, Noor’s drinks and plates, and Eli’s gas and utilities descend through a literal field map into the group.
options.risk: The landscape reads like a trip even though the mechanism must work for everyday groups too.

options.label: The Circular Ledger
options.lineage: social diagram and annotated group ledger
options.thesis: Different purchases circulate around the group until contribution comes back naturally.
options.viewport: Jamie, Noor, and Eli surround a Weekend crew ledger; their exact purchases form a circular path that continues into the phone-ring reveal.
options.risk: The phrase about not counting every cent must not imply that SettleUp is financially imprecise.
